newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-TRANSVAAL 6-1 IN REPLY TO FREE STATE'S 251.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TRANSVAAL 6-1 IN REPLY TO FREE STATE'S 251.

text.p: Free State lost their last six wickets for only eight runs to toss away a strong position on the first day of their four-day Supersport series match against Transvaal at Springbok Park on Friday.

Wayne Kidwell picked up four wickets for Transvaal as Free State crashed from 197 for three to be 251 all out. Skipper Ken Rutherford was dismissed for a duck as Transvaal reached six for one in their reply by the close.
Rutherford's decision to insert Free State looked to have backfired as Deon Jordaan (57) and Chris Craven (64) took their side to 189 for three at tea.
But a fiery spell from Kidwell in the final session backed by Ross Veenstra saw Free State fall away badly.
Bowling: Kidwell 26-6-54-4, Hall 9-1-34-0, Jacobs 23-11-34-2, Veenstra 16.1-0-61-3, Laing 11-3-32-1, Eksteen 11-1-27-0
